title: Comercio y cooperación
goal: Read how NAFTA boosted Mexican export manufacturing, the 1994 US proposal for a hemispheric free-trade zone and Chávez's rejection of it, and the region's growing number of overlapping trade agreements.

items: Explain what NAFTA transformed in Mexican manufacturing.
Explain what the 1994 Miami proposal envisioned from Alaska to Tierra del Fuego.
Describe Chávez's rejection of the ALCA free-trade proposal.
Describe the region's many overlapping trade agreements.
Use así las cosas to resume narration after describing a situation.
